metadata.title: zERC20 Privacy Token Protocol - Audit Map Batch 10

audit_results.title: Verify zERC20._update correctly updates balances

phase_1_predicate_formalization.formal_predicate: For all transfers: balanceOf[from]_post = balanceOf[from]_pre - value AND balanceOf[to]_post = balanceOf[to]_pre + value (ERC20 standard behavior from OpenZeppelin)

phase_2_counterexample_construction.combination_attacks: from == to self-transfers handled by ERC20

phase_3_guard_evaluation.rationale: Inherits battle-tested OpenZeppelin ERC20Upgradeable implementation. 248-bit constraint enforced before delegation to super._update(). No custom balance manipulation.

phase_5_classification.rationale: Balance updates are correctly implemented via OpenZeppelin ERC20Upgradeable inheritance. The 248-bit constraint is enforced before delegation to ensure ZK-compatibility. No exploitable vulnerabilities found.

audit_results.title: Verify zERC20._update correctly updates hash chain

phase_1_predicate_formalization.formal_predicate: For all transfers: hashChain_post = ShaHashChainLib.compute(hashChain_pre, from, to, value) AND index_post = index_pre + 1

phase_2_counterexample_construction.type_confusion: N/A - addresses and uint256 are fixed types
phase_2_counterexample_construction.timing_attacks: Hash chain is updated atomically in same tx

guards_identified: zERC20._update line 159: $.hashChain = ShaHashChainLib.compute($.hashChain, from, to, value)
phase_3_guard_evaluation.rationale: Hash chain computation is deterministic and atomic. SHA-256 provides collision resistance. 248-bit truncation maintains BN254 field compatibility.

phase_4_attack_vector_analysis.input_validation_bypass: Not possible - inputs are from ERC20 transfer context
phase_4_attack_vector_analysis.state_transition_violation: Not possible - hash chain is append-only

phase_5_classification.rationale: Hash chain is correctly computed and updated atomically with every transfer. The 248-bit truncation ensures ZK-circuit compatibility. Index increment provides monotonic ordering.

audit_results.title: Verify zERC20._update emits IndexedTransfer event

phase_1_predicate_formalization.formal_predicate: For all transfers: emit IndexedTransfer(index, from, to, value) where index matches current transfer index

phase_2_counterexample_construction.type_confusion: N/A - event parameters are strongly typed

guards_identified: zERC20._update line 160: emit IndexedTransfer($.index, from, to, value)
phase_3_guard_evaluation.rationale: Event is emitted unconditionally on every transfer with correct parameters. Index is read before increment, ensuring correct ordering.

phase_5_classification.rationale: IndexedTransfer event is correctly emitted with proper parameters for off-chain indexing. This supports the subgraph/prover pipeline.

audit_results.title: Verify transfer operation completes successfully

phase_1_predicate_formalization.formal_predicate: For all valid transfers: tx succeeds AND balances updated AND hashChain updated AND event emitted

guards_identified: zERC20._update: atomic execution of all state changes
phase_3_guard_evaluation.rationale: Transfer is atomic - either all state changes complete or the entire transaction reverts. No partial state possible.

phase_5_classification.rationale: Transfer operations complete atomically with all state changes. OpenZeppelin ERC20 guarantees are preserved.

audit_results.title: Verify Verifier.reserveHashChain snapshots correctly

phase_1_predicate_formalization.formal_predicate: reserveHashChain() reads (index, hashChain) from zERC20 AND stores reservedHashChains[index] = hashChain AND updates latestReservedIndex
preconditions: Verifier is connected to valid zERC20

phase_2_counterexample_construction.type_confusion: N/A - uint64 and uint256 properly cast

guards_identified: Verifier.reserveHashChain line 255-258: atomic read and store
phase_3_guard_evaluation.rationale: Function correctly reads from zERC20 and stores the checkpoint. Overwriting is allowed by design (provers compete for checkpoints). No access control - any caller can reserve.

phase_4_attack_vector_analysis.resource_exhaustion: Unbounded mapping growth possible but controlled by index

phase_5_classification.rationale: Hash chain reservation correctly snapshots zERC20 state. Permissionless by design to allow any prover to participate.

audit_results.title: Verify IncentiveLib handles mathematical edge cases

phase_1_predicate_formalization.formal_predicate: quoteWrapReward(L=0) returns max reward AND quoteWrapReward(L>=T) returns 0 AND quoteUnwrapFee(L>=T) returns 0 AND amount=0 returns 0
postconditions: Edge cases produce mathematically correct results

guards_identified: IncentiveLib._rawWrapReward line 194-196: T==0 or amount==0 returns 0
IncentiveLib._rawWrapReward line 206: start capped at T
IncentiveLib._rawWrapReward line 213: end capped at T
phase_3_guard_evaluation.rationale: All edge cases are explicitly handled with early returns. Clamping ensures integration bounds stay within [0, T]. Overflow is prevented by validation.

phase_4_attack_vector_analysis.faulty_error_handling: N/A - no reverts in edge cases

phase_5_classification.rationale: IncentiveLib correctly handles all mathematical edge cases including L=0, L>=T, amount=0, and T=0. Reward uses floor rounding; fee uses ceiling rounding.

audit_results.title: Verify IMintableBurnableERC20 implementation enforces onlyMinter

phase_1_predicate_formalization.formal_predicate: mint() and burn() only succeed if msg.sender == minter()

phase_3_guard_evaluation.rationale: Both mint and burn check msg.sender against minter() getter. Unauthorized callers cannot mint or burn tokens.

phase_4_attack_vector_analysis.input_validation_bypass: Not possible - msg.sender cannot be spoofed

phase_5_classification.rationale: mint() and burn() correctly enforce onlyMinter restriction. LiquidityManager is the authorized minter for wrap/unwrap flows.

audit_results.title: Verify LiquidityManager maintains underlyingBalance >= feeSurplus invariant

phase_1_predicate_formalization.formal_predicate: For all states: underlyingBalance() >= feeSurplus AND unwrap reverts if amount > (balance - feeSurplus) AND withdrawRewards reverts if amount > feeSurplus

guards_identified: LiquidityManager._quoteUnwrapFee line 247: liquidity = balance >= feeSurplus_ ? balance - feeSurplus_ : 0
phase_3_guard_evaluation.rationale: Liquidity calculations correctly subtract feeSurplus. Unwrap checks actual balance before transfer. withdrawRewards is capped by feeSurplus.

phase_4_attack_vector_analysis.state_transition_violation: External balance changes could cause temporary inconsistency but fail-safe

phase_5_classification.rationale: LiquidityManager maintains solvency invariant. Fee surplus is tracked separately from available liquidity. Unwrap correctly respects liquidity bounds.

audit_results.title: Verify user can generate stealth address off-chain

phase_1_predicate_formalization.formal_predicate: User generates GeneralRecipient struct with (chainId, recipient, tweak, version) AND hash(GeneralRecipient) produces unique recipient identifier

guards_identified: GeneralRecipientLib.hash(): Poseidon hash of (chainId, recipient, tweak, version)
phase_3_guard_evaluation.rationale: Off-chain stealth address generation is documented but not enforced on-chain. On-chain verification uses GeneralRecipient.hash() to match proof recipient.

phase_5_classification.rationale: Stealth address generation is an off-chain SDK concern. On-chain contracts only verify the hash matches. SDK implementation should be reviewed separately.
phase_5_classification.recommendation: Verify SDK stealth address generation matches on-chain verification expectations

audit_results.title: Verify user can generate Nova proof off-chain

phase_1_predicate_formalization.formal_predicate: User or prover generates valid Nova IVC proof that passes on-chain verification via rootDecider or withdrawDecider

phase_3_guard_evaluation.rationale: On-chain verification delegates to external verifier contracts. Nova IVC soundness is enforced by the cryptographic library.

phase_5_classification.rationale: Nova proof generation is an off-chain prover concern. On-chain contracts correctly verify proofs via trusted verifier contracts. Prover implementation should be reviewed.
phase_5_classification.recommendation: Verify prover implementation and sonobe library version

audit_results.title: Verify user state after obtaining Nova proof

phase_1_predicate_formalization.formal_predicate: After proof generation: user holds valid proof blob that can be submitted to teleport() or proveTransferRoot()

phase_2_counterexample_construction.timing_attacks: Root may become stale before submission

guards_identified: Proof validity is checked on submission
phase_3_guard_evaluation.rationale: User state is off-chain. Proof validity is only enforced upon on-chain submission.

phase_4_attack_vector_analysis.race_conditions: Root staleness handled by rootHint parameter

phase_5_classification.rationale: Off-chain user state is not enforced by contracts. rootHint parameter allows flexible proof submission timing.

audit_results.title: Verify owner can rotate verifier contracts

phase_1_predicate_formalization.formal_predicate: setVerifiers() with valid addresses updates all 5 verifier pointers atomically AND only owner can call

guards_identified: Verifier.setVerifiers line 481-486: require all addresses non-zero
phase_3_guard_evaluation.rationale: setVerifiers is protected by onlyOwner and validates all addresses. Atomic update prevents partial rotation.

phase_5_classification.rationale: Verifier rotation is correctly implemented with onlyOwner protection and zero-address validation.
phase_5_classification.recommendation: None - implementation is correct. Owner should coordinate rotation with pending proofs.

audit_results.title: Verify owner can deactivate emergency mode

phase_1_predicate_formalization.formal_predicate: deactivateEmergency() unpauses contract AND only owner can call

phase_3_guard_evaluation.rationale: deactivateEmergency is protected by onlyOwner. Delegates to PausableUpgradeable._unpause() which handles already-unpaused case.

phase_5_classification.rationale: Emergency deactivation correctly implemented with onlyOwner protection.

audit_results.title: Verify system state after emergency recovery

phase_1_predicate_formalization.formal_predicate: After deactivateEmergency(): paused() == false AND all functions with whenNotPaused become callable

phase_3_guard_evaluation.rationale: OpenZeppelin Pausable correctly tracks pause state. All key functions check whenNotPaused.

phase_4_attack_vector_analysis.state_transition_violation: Root conflicts must be resolved externally

phase_5_classification.rationale: Emergency recovery correctly restores system functionality. Root conflict resolution is owner responsibility.
phase_5_classification.recommendation: Document operational procedure for resolving root conflicts before deactivating emergency

audit_results.title: Verify enableSelfCall reverts when already enabled

phase_1_predicate_formalization.formal_predicate: _enableSelfCallBefore() reverts with SelfCallAlreadyEnabled if SELF_CALL_STORAGE already true

phase_3_guard_evaluation.rationale: Uses transient storage (EIP-1153) which is cleared after each transaction. Nested enableSelfCall within same tx reverts.

phase_5_classification.rationale: SelfCall pattern correctly prevents nested enableSelfCall. Transient storage ensures clean state per transaction.

audit_results.title: Verify Adaptor SelfCall-protected functions reject external calls

phase_1_predicate_formalization.formal_predicate: unwrapSelf, bridgeUnderlyingTokenSelf, bridgeZerc20Self revert unless (msg.sender == address(this) AND selfCallEnabled)

phase_3_guard_evaluation.rationale: onlySelfCall requires BOTH msg.sender == address(this) AND transient flag enabled. External callers fail the msg.sender check. Internal calls without enableSelfCall modifier fail the flag check.

phase_5_classification.rationale: Adaptor correctly implements SelfCall pattern. External callers cannot invoke *Self functions. The dual-condition check prevents bypasses.

audit_results.title: Verify governance functions restricted by onlyOwner or onlyRole

phase_1_predicate_formalization.formal_predicate: All admin functions protected by onlyOwner or onlyRole(ROLE) AND unauthorized callers revert
postconditions: Only authorized callers can execute admin functions

phase_3_guard_evaluation.rationale: All admin functions are protected by appropriate access control modifiers from OpenZeppelin.

phase_5_classification.rationale: All governance functions are correctly protected by access control. Owner operations are out of audit scope per trust model.

audit_results.title: Verify Hub Poseidon aggregation is correct

phase_1_predicate_formalization.formal_predicate: broadcast() computes Poseidon aggregation root from transfer roots AND increments aggSeq AND broadcasts to registered verifiers

phase_3_guard_evaluation.rationale: Broadcast validates all inputs, computes deterministic Poseidon tree, and sends to all targets atomically.

phase_4_attack_vector_analysis.state_transition_violation: Snapshot is taken at call time

phase_5_classification.rationale: Hub aggregation is correctly implemented with PoseidonT3 tree. Snapshot ensures consistent root computation.

audit_results.title: Verify IC canister provides confidential key derivation

phase_1_predicate_formalization.formal_predicate: IC canister derives encryption keys via vetKd AND AES-GCM encrypts user data

guards_identified: Off-chain: vetKd canister provides threshold key derivation
phase_3_guard_evaluation.rationale: IC canister integration is semi-trusted per trust model. On-chain contracts do not interact with IC directly.

phase_5_classification.rationale: IC canister integration is off-chain and semi-trusted. Cannot verify from smart contract audit alone.
phase_5_classification.recommendation: Separate security review of IC canister integration and vetKd usage

code_references: Off-chain component - not in Solidity codebase

audit_results.title: Verify incentive curve implementation matches specification

phase_1_predicate_formalization.formal_predicate: IncentiveLib implements density ρ(x) = k × (1 - x/T) AND reward = floor(∫ρ dx) AND fee = ceil(∫ρ dx)

guards_identified: IncentiveLib.validateFeeParams: T <= MAX_TARGET_LIQUIDITY, k <= K_BPS_DENOM, k * T * T no overflow
phase_3_guard_evaluation.rationale: Implementation matches the mathematical specification in the library header. Rounding direction is correct for protocol favorability.

phase_5_classification.rationale: IncentiveLib correctly implements the piecewise linear density function. Reward rounds down (protocol-favorable), fee rounds up (protocol-favorable).

key_findings.title: Off-chain Components Require Separate Review
key_findings.description: Several checklist items relate to off-chain components (SDK stealth address generation, prover implementation, IC canister integration) that cannot be verified from smart contract code alone.
key_findings.recommendation: Conduct separate security reviews of: 1) SDK implementation, 2) Prover service and sonobe library, 3) IC canister integration

key_findings.title: All On-Chain Implementations Verified Correct
key_findings.description: All on-chain implementations for zERC20 transfers, hash chain updates, SelfCall pattern, governance controls, Hub aggregation, and incentive calculations are correctly implemented.
key_findings.recommendation: No action required for on-chain components

verification_recommendations: Review SDK stealth address generation matches on-chain GeneralRecipientLib.hash()
Verify sonobe/folding-schemes library version and audit status
